# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 18 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launch & GLS Market

- **New condo sales hit a 2-year low in June** - Developers sold just 156 private homes (excluding ECs) in June 2026 — the lowest monthly figure since February 2024 — with no new project launches, mid-year school holidays, and seasonal factors all contributing to the dip. A rebound is expected in July as new launches come to market. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/developers-new-home-sales-fall-to-a-2-year-low-in-june-rebound-expected-in-july/)

- **Bayshore Drive GLS site draws record $2.13 billion top bid** - A Frasers Property-led joint venture submitted the highest offer of S$2.128 billion (S$1,323 psf ppr) for the mixed-use Bayshore Drive GLS site — the largest bid ever recorded for a Government Land Sales plot outside Singapore's CBD. The tender, part of the 1H2026 Confirmed List, attracted three bids in total. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/bayshore-drive-gls-1280-homes-integrated-mrt/)

## HDB Resale & Housing Policy

- **Queenstown 2-room flat sets new national resale record at S$696,000** - A high-floor 2-room HDB flat at SkyParc @ Dawson in Queenstown changed hands for S$696,000 on 15 July 2026, breaking the previous national record for a flat of that type. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/2-room-national-record-broken-as-queenstown-unit-sells-for-s696000/)

- **Community Care Apartments opened to seniors from age 55, with fees cut by up to 75%** - The Government — through MOH, MND and HDB — is lowering the minimum eligible age for Community Care Apartments from 65 to 55, and reducing mandatory monthly service fees by between 18% and 75% to widen access to this housing option. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/community-care-apartments-seniors-from-age-55-fees-reduced-by-up-to-75/)

## Rental Market

- **Condo and HDB rents edge higher in June after May lull** - Singapore's rental market recovered in June 2026, with both condo and HDB rents moving up and leasing transaction volumes picking up broadly, according to the 99-SRX Rental Flash Report. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-hdb-rental-market-rebound-june-2026/)
